## Profile attachment

In ControllerKeys, right-click your profile → **Share to Community…**. Review the
shared copy, then save the submission. Drag the prepared `.json` file here.
Screenshots are welcome. You can also attach an exported profile manually after
removing controller identities, private text, credentials and machine-specific actions.

- [ ] I tested this setup and described any requirements.
- [ ] I reviewed the profile and description for private data.
- [ ] I agree to publish this profile in the ControllerKeys community library under the repository's PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license.

Submissions are reviewed by a maintainer before entering the library.
